name: The Memory Keeper's Treehouse
description: A massive treehouse built around an ancient tree whose bark displays flickering memories like fireflies - happy moments, adventures, and quiet reflections.
prompt: A sprawling treehouse village nestled in the branches of a colossal ancient tree whose trunk is covered in bark that flickers with soft golden memory fragments like fireflies. Tiny windows glow with warm light where little figures can be seen living out cherished moments - birthday parties, first kisses, family gatherings. Rope bridges connect treehouses shaped like vintage cameras, music boxes, and storybooks. The tree's leaves shimmer with autumn gold and emerald green. Cozy fantasy atmosphere, nostalgic warmth, detailed rustic textures.
caption: This tree remembers every smile, every tear, every moment worth keeping forever... 💛🏠
